risk_if_not_implemented: Without Maintenance Tools, maintenance activities may introduce unauthorized changes, expose systems to untrusted personnel or tools, or leave systems in an unsafe state. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Unauthorized Modification / Loss of System Integrity (R-AM-2), Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Fraud, Corruption and/or Intentional Criminal Conduct (MT-14).

compensating_control_1.name: Integrity Assurance & Enforcement (IAE)
compensating_control_1.description:
Automated mechanisms exist to:
(1) Identify unauthorized deviations from an approved secure baseline configuration; and
(2) Implement automated resiliency actions to remediate the unauthorized change.
compensating_control_1.justification: Integrity Assurance & Enforcement (IAE) (CFG-08.2) provides configuration hardening that compensates for the absence of Maintenance Tools (MNT-11) by eliminating unnecessary services and enforcing secure settings to reduce inherent exposure. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Maintenance Tools (MNT-11) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
